# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **Binding delivery improvements**

## Highlights

The next SkiaSharp release improves packaged documentation and keeps generated bindings aligned with bundled native libraries. NuGet packages now include XML documentation sidecars, while the P/Invoke and HarfBuzz binding generation pipelines are reorganized for more reliable maintenance.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## API Surface

- **XML documentation ships with NuGet packages** — SkiaSharp packages now include XML documentation sidecars so IDEs can show API documentation directly from the installed package. ([#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066))
- **Bindings track bundled native sources** — P/Invoke bindings are organized by native type, and HarfBuzz bindings are generated from the same pinned source revision used for the bundled native library. ([#5056](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5056), [#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
